output.summary: Nurse staffing is stable (hours per visit, vacancy, grid adherence), and volume, acuity, bed count and occupancy are flat. About 3.0 of the 3.2 h rise sits in boarding, which jumped in March when hospitalist rounding moved to 09:30 with new admissions first. Surgical wards, the control, show no discharge shift. The 4 West pilot, with huddle days set by a pre-existing rotation and balanced on volume and census, cut boarding from 4.6 to 2.3 h, which supports causation. The evening cleaning cut (September) cannot be assessed because turnaround data are missing. Extend the huddle and track it. Reject the travel-nurse contract funded by deferring case managers, and reject pausing the huddle.
